name: Top Smoke Pre-Roll 28pk | OG Kush
description: OG Kush is a hybrid strain made by crossing Chemdawg x Lemon Thai x Hindu Kush. This strain will give you a head and body effect. It's often enjoyed in the back half of the day to ease stress. 28 one gram pre-rolls.
